text:
Maya: Follow-up from the gateway RFC: hedging + throttles are causing retry storms in staging. Need a pragmatic refactor.
Ben: Saw it in the load run. Tenants with small quotas got hedged multiple times and hit concurrency drops.
Priya: Pattern: hedge -> upstream queue growth -> throttle kicks -> reject -> immediate client retry -> back to hedge. Bad loop.
Javier: Proposal: split admission into billing_quota (strict) and hedge_quota (soft). Hedge_quota tracked as a tiny local lease in proxies.
Maya: So proxies have a local fastpath token check and periodic async reconciliation to central store. No per-request control-plane calls.
Ben: Lease sizing: small for hot tenants (1-3), larger for cold tenants. Prevents large oversubscribe windows.
Priya: Observability: emit hedging events with tags: route, model, tenant, outcome. New metrics: hedged_allowed, hedged_denied, hedged_latency_p90, hedge_leases_remaining.
Maya: Config sketch: edge_hedging routes (/v1/chat, /v1/embeddings) per-route budgets and window seconds.
Javier: Implementation note: keep local checks lock-free using atomics per worker and a background reconciler that tops up leases.
Ben: When hedge denied return header: X-Redwood-Hedge: denied; retry-after=150ms to discourage immediate client retries.
Priya: Reconciliation job should credit leases back if a hedged request is cancelled before execution. Also emit reconciliation drift metric.
Maya: Rollout: feature-flagged canary per-cluster, enable for low-QPS tenants first. Watch correlation between hedged_denied spikes and tenant errors.
infra-bot: Canary plan created: https://deploys.redwood/internal/plan/1342
Javier: I'll spike the lease cache and a tiny simulator.
Ben: I'll mock dashboards and alerts.
Priya: I'll draft an RFC addendum with schema, reconciliation pseudocode, and rollout steps.
Maya: Thanks. We'll review Friday in arch sync. :thumbsup:
